india_context.procedural_notes: Section 94 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 (BNSS) (formerly Section 91 CrPC) empowers courts and police officers to summon documents necessary for investigation or trial.
india_context.transitional_notes: Article 20(3) of Constitution shields accused persons from being compelled to produce self-incriminatory private documents (State of Gujarat v. Shyamlal Mohanlal).
verification_requirements: Verify whether recipient is named as accused or merely witness in FIR/complaint.
